description: Liam, 2026-11-05 (D62, replacing D50's plan/ half), maximum priority. Update the corpus in tests/test_claude_hook_corpus.py, the hook's header and message, and CLAUDE.md's D62 wording, and add to CLAUDE.md the step that a plan/ branch queues its own merge with `gh pr merge <branch> --auto --squash`, as brief/ does (D33). The audit's narrowed rules (automation 3) moved to J103; this job does not wait for J78.
title: plan/ merges itself on green CI: the hook stops denying it
